## Checks

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (check, lint, test, build, check:dist). Paste any warnings below.
- [ ] Home page HTML is under 14 KB and first load is under 106 KB.

## Hard rules (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)

- [ ] Static output only: no server code, database, login, forms or analytics.
- [ ] No third-party requests at runtime: self-hosted fonts, no CDNs, embeds, trackers or cookies.
- [ ] CSP stays strict: no inline script or style, no `eval`. Any exception was discussed first.
- [ ] No new dependency, or it was approved, pinned to an exact version and the lockfile is committed.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, real IP addresses, personal file paths or graded USD coursework.
- [ ] No write-ups of active Hack The Box machines.
- [ ] Keyboard reachable with visible focus, `prefers-reduced-motion` honoured, works with JavaScript off.

## Review

- [ ] My edits are finished and nobody else is editing this branch.
- [ ] The diff was reviewed and every finding is fixed or answered below.
- [ ] Merged by pull request into protected `main`.
